info.name: High-Traffic News Feed API
info.description:
Scenario collection: run top to bottom (Collection Runner or `npx newman run postman/high-traffic-feed.postman_collection.json`).

Set `base_url` to `http://localhost:8080/api` (Docker) or `http://localhost:8000/api` (`php artisan serve`). Tokens, ids and cursors are chained through collection variables automatically.

Every error has the same envelope: `{ message, code, errors }`.

item.name: 1. Auth
item.description: Registers two fresh users every run (random emails), so the collection works on an empty or seeded database.

exec: pm.test("Sorted newest first", () => { const ids = j.data.map(p => p.id); pm.expect(ids).to.eql([...ids].sort((a, b) => b - a)); });
